meta.title: Handimen — Share what you have
meta.description: Share tools, equipment, and skills with your neighbours in Poblenou.

home.title: Share tools, equipment, and skills with your neighbours
home.subtitle: Handimen is a neighbourhood network that combines a social feed with peer-to-peer lending. Borrow, rent, or share for free — and find out who nearby can lend a hand.

features.title: Everything you need to share
features.subtitle: The Phase 0 foundation is ready. These are the pieces already holding the product up.

feed.title: Neighbourhood feed
feed.description: Post what you have or what you need. Reactions and comments so the neighbourhood can respond.

lending.title: Lending & renting
lending.description: Free or paid listings with requests, a calendar, and in-person pickup.

trust.title: Tiered trust
trust.description: Progressive verification, two-way reviews, and community vouching.

local.title: Local discovery
local.description: Radius search with PostGIS, category filters, and private communities.

trust.title: Trust, in tiers
trust.subtitle: Verification scales with risk — keeping cost low while safety grows.

tier0.title: Tier 0 · Free
tier0.description: Verified email, completed profile, reviews, reporting, and vouching.

tier1.title: Tier 1 · Phone
tier1.description: Only for paid listings or a first lend. Keeps SMS spend low.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: From power tools to skills and one-off help.

items.monorepo: pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with shared packages

items.payments: PaymentsProvider interface with a mock provider
